resale_co.name: Certificate of Sale (Certificate of Re-sale)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Totowa, Office of the Construction Official (Building Department), under Borough Code Chapter 153-14
resale_co.lead_time: Not stated for the certificate; the Water Department's meter compliance application in the same packet must be filed at least 2 weeks before closing
requirements: Address clearly marked on the house and mailbox
Smoke alarm on every level and within 10 feet of sleeping areas; carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of sleeping areas (Fire Bureau certificate)
Copy of a property survey, if available
Private well: a clean well test (or a letter from both attorneys noting the well's condition)
Check for open permits, illegal construction and illegal 2-family or multi-family use
Gas appliance vents installed properly; water heater, furnace, boiler or stove chimney connection sealed and secure
All meters installed (gas, electric, water); water meter with an external reading device
Water heater pressure relief pipe extends to within 6 inches of the floor
Grip-size handrails on steps with 4 or more risers; guardrails on porches, steps and walkways more than 30 inches above grade
No loose or unprotected wires or open electric boxes; hardwired ground fault receptacle for pools and spas
All required fire separations installed and maintained
Buyers bring photo ID for all adults who will live in the home and birth certificates for minor children
The 2024 packet also lists a portable fire extinguisher (2.5 to 10 lb ABC within 10 feet of the kitchen); the Fire Bureau's current sheet says it is no longer required

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Certificate of Sale packet for 1 or 2 family dwellings from the Borough Forms page, complete the Certificate of Sale application (Office of the Construction Official), the Fire Bureau smoke/CO application and the Water Department meter compliance application, and submit them at the Municipal Complex, 537 Totowa Road, with two checks payable to the Borough of Totowa (one for the resale certificate, one for the fire certificate). Include a survey if available and a clean well test if the home has a private well.

resale_co.notes: The Certificate of Sale packet (scanned, dated April 26, 2024) cites Borough Code Chapter 153-14 and asks for two checks payable to the Borough of Totowa: $100.00 each for a single family (one for the resale certificate, one for the fire certificate) or $200.00 each for a two family. The packet also has a Certificate of Code Compliance inspection report signed off by the Tax Assessor, Zoning Officer, Housing Officer, Fire Marshal, Property Maintenance Officer and Building Department; any non-conformance needs approval from the C/O Review Committee. No reinspection fee or validity period is published. The Building Department page also lists James Booth as Zoning Inspector / Housing Officer / Property Maintenance Inspector (Wednesday and Friday, 7:30 to 8:30am or 4:30 to 6:00pm). Rentals use a separate 'Dwelling Certificate & Smoke Detector Certificate for Rentals' form and landlord registration, which are not resale requirements.

requirements: One smoke alarm in the basement and on each floor (unfinished attics excluded), and within 10 feet of the outside of bedroom doors
Battery-only smoke alarms must have a 10-year sealed lithium battery (since 1/1/19); all smoke alarms less than 10 years old and UL listed
Existing hardwired smoke or smoke/CO alarms must stay hardwired and cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of bedrooms (outside the bedroom), less than 10 years old; CO alarms on all floors recommended
Monitored alarm systems must be tested or serviced first, with a report from the alarm company (detectors under 10 years old) available to the inspector
Fire extinguisher no longer required (per the Fire Bureau sheet); the 2024 Certificate of Sale packet still lists one

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete the Fire Bureau Application (smoke detector and carbon monoxide) in the Certificate of Sale packet and submit it with a separate check payable to the Borough of Totowa at the Municipal Complex, 537 Totowa Road, 2nd floor. No closing may take place without the completed certificate of inspection.

fire_cert.notes: The fire certificate fee ($100.00 single family, $200.00 two family) appears on the Fire Bureau application inside the Borough's Certificate of Sale packet (scanned April 2024), which still shows the former Fire Marshal Richard Schopperth and phone 973-956-7929; the current Fire Official is Mark Henry per the Fire Bureau page, the Borough's Smoke Detector Requirements sheet and the state directory, so those older contact details are not used. On the Fire Bureau page the email link behind 'mhenry@totowanj.org' points to cspinella@totowanj.org; the displayed address matches the requirements sheet and the state directory. The fee is flat (no lead-time tiers are published), and there is no published reinspection fee or lead time. The Totowa Fire Department (volunteer, Chief Vincent Marciano) handles emergency response.

other_items.label: Water meter compliance (Water Department)
other_items.detail: Submit the Water Meter Compliance Application to the Water Department office at 537 Totowa Road at least 2 weeks before closing; a site inspection sets the cost of any required meter upgrade and checks the curb box (Ordinances 407-12, 407-17, 407-25).

other_items.label: Open permits and illegal construction
other_items.detail: The Certificate of Sale inspection checks for open permits, illegal construction and illegal 2-family or multi-family use.

other_items.label: Private well test
other_items.detail: Homes on private wells must submit a clean well test under the Private Well Testing Act, or a letter from both attorneys noting the well's condition.
